final_message:
I've written the June 2026 trend analysis for ABC Inc. It's a draft: every number in it comes from the analysis script, and I added the commentary in section 1 with the DRAFT banner left in place. The report covers Jan 2025 through Jun 2026 (18 months), and June 2026 is the latest month in the workbook.

**Data quality:** all checks pass. Every subtotal matches its detail rows, the sheet's own gross profit, operating income and net income figures match, and the balance sheet balances. There were no structural warnings, and June is not flagged as a partial month.

**Main points:**
- **Revenue:** 195,898 in June, down 6.0% from May (208,351). May was the highest month in the export, and June is roughly in line with the prior six-month average (−0.5%) and up 2.8% on Jun 2025.
- **Gross margin:** 70.2%, up 3.1 points from May and equal to the six-month average, but 4.2 points below Jun 2025 (74.3%).
- **Losses:** a net loss of (330,756), the sixth negative month in a row. Net income over the last 12 months is (3,089,780). The one profitable month, Dec 2025, is positive only because of a 1,244,430 income tax benefit.
- **Cash:** 713,481, down 215,543 from May and 1,871,836 from six months earlier. Liabilities rose from 618,024 to 1,002,176 over the same six months.
- **Costs to look at:** Events & Conferences rose 17,971 to 29,295. Bad Debts is a credit of (1,806), which makes the Finance & Admin category negative this month; I've left it to the reviewer to confirm what that credit is.

**"Other" category:** one expense account, General Expenses (149 in June, 16,158 over 12 months), didn't match any category rule.
